verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents that Claude loads skills when a natural-language request matches a skill's description, with explicit `/skill-name` invocation as a fallback (docs-2, docs-25, docs-17, docs-32), and that skills can be created conversationally via skill-creator (docs-13, docs-30). Hands-on reports concretely contradict the automatic triggering: users say skills are not invoked from expected prompts and must be named explicitly, sometimes failing even when asked (comm-12, comm-13), and Vercel's cited evals found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases (comm-14). Missing for 10: reliable invocation from natural-language prompts alone, and independent evidence that triggering works as documented.
